newsitem.title: USA: Sound Advice sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Sound Advice sets holder rights plan.

text.p: Sound Advice Inc said Wednesday that it adopted a common stock purchase rights plan and declared a dividend distribution of one common stock purchase right on each outstanding share of common stock.

Sound Advice said the rights are designed to ensure that all Sound Advice's shareholders receive fair treatment in the event of a takeover, to guard against partial tender offers and other coercive tactics to gain control that might provide inadequate value to shareholders.
A Sound Advice spokesman said the measure is precautionary and not in response to any attempt to take over the company.

Each right has an initial exercise price of $12.00 for one share of common. The rights will be exercisable if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of Sound Advice's common stock, or 10 percent of such stock under certain circumstances.
The company said the rights plan is similar to those adopted by many other public companies.
